cohorts.name: larger-training-domains
cohorts.outcome: Mixed: strong 32/64 cube gains; small and larger-rectangular regressions
cohorts.followup: Independent 32-cube native trajectory: expanded completes 113 post-warmup steps; small-only rejects first request.

cohorts.name: frozen-model-numerical-correction
cohorts.outcome: Promising: C53 before-six, C44 before/after-seven and C37 before/after-ten qualify all standard requests
cohorts.followup: Intermediate-pass sweeps, separate native checks, six-pass 3600-step trajectory, matched quiet timing.

cohorts.name: finer-teacher-timesteps
cohorts.outcome: Small matched improvement at half-step; no monotonic quarter-step improvement and no gain over original C53 at eight passes
cohorts.limitation: Fixed-equation pressure requests from finer teacher states; not a learned fine-integrated coarse full-state transition.

cohorts.name: numerical-coarse-neural-fine
cohorts.outcome: Promising: 103/128 at four passes, 128/128 at five; eight-pass worst residual about 9.07e-10
cohorts.followup: Intermediate pass sweep and native budget tests; transfers, coarse solve and all fine stages timed.

cohorts.name: sparse-numerical-anchors
cohorts.outcome: No general advantage from this exact-anchor construction; standard and large-grid regressions remain
cohorts.limitation: Anchors require a global transform/all-mode solve and selected inverse; their full cost is included.

cohorts.name: revised-learned-coarse-fine
cohorts.outcome: Positive gated low-mode branch is finite and trainable; Improved standard-request worst residual
cohorts.followup: Separate 1000x rate for the 63 newly added logits; same fine rates, loss, data, initialization and inference.

cohorts.name: spacing-training-and-conditioning
cohorts.outcome: Explicit spacing does not improve independent-spacing worst error over its matched zero-feature control
cohorts.followup: Twelve independently reserved validation trajectories, 24 requests at 4/8/16/32 cells per metre.

cohorts.name: periodic-numerical-correction
cohorts.outcome: Eight-pass periodic policies remain below declared drift limits over the tested horizons; periodic correction does not rescue rejected four-pass requests
cohorts.followup: Three development scenes at 512 steps; first-scene native/full-numerical/neural/periodic controls extended to 3600 steps.

scope: Development research on sealed uniform cubic water grids. No original reserved-test scenes, model promotion or production deployment.
runtime_scope: Quiet prepared-pressure timing includes all numerical/neural stages and final residual. Native times are instrumented dual-track diagnostic costs, not single-track production timings.
original_chart: Historical chart and its different timing scope remain unchanged.
limits: Single training seed per new arm; these are bounded controlled comparisons, not exhaustive optimization.
Matched optimizer-update budgets; tier sampling changes per-parent exposure and forward-cell work when larger domains are added.
64-cube model requests evaluated offline; coupled larger-domain followup uses 32-cube. Production 256/512/1024 deferred.
Arbitrary geometry, obstacles, free surfaces and variable mass density are outside the current model/operator contract.
